contradicting_evidence: Current price action and participation are positive: BTC and ETH gained over both the supplied hour and 24-hour comparison, while 67% of the breadth universe advanced.

The filtered mid-alt and Top-100-tail proxies had positive median returns and positive participation. Persistent readings of this kind could develop into stronger transmission, although one snapshot does not establish it.

The 90-day context remains constructive in absolute terms: BTC returned approximately 26.08% and the median constituent alt returned approximately 22.28%. The weak 30-day window therefore does not establish an uninterrupted longer-term decline.
One negative ETF session does not establish a persistent outflow regime. Stablecoin supply contraction measures reduced liquidity capacity, not confirmed selling or deployment.
frozen_forecast.expected_path: A weak downward net bias over the week, more plausibly expressed through fading rebounds and renewed retests than an uninterrupted decline. Observed supply contraction and the latest settled outflows give downside pressure a modest advantage unless price resilience becomes persistent and participation improves. This is not a confirmed breakdown or cycle-transition forecast.
falsification_conditions: Sustained BTC and ETH recovery accompanied by stable or stronger ETH/BTC and repeated broad participation would undermine the downside bias.
An improving settled ETF-flow sequence together with stabilizing stablecoin supply would weaken the principal liquidity-headwind argument.
Persistent positive price and breadth follow-through despite the negative flow and supply backdrop would show that those headwinds are not dominating this horizon.
missing_evidence: A current multi-session ETF-flow sequence and subsequent stablecoin-supply observations.
Daily price and relative-strength follow-through sufficient to distinguish a durable recovery from a rebound.
Canonical breadth confirmation, participation outside the Top-100 proxy and any microcap evidence.
Reliable catalyst coverage and updated macro changes relevant to the forecast week.
supporting_evidence: Stablecoin supply declined 0.272% over one day, 1.293% over seven days and 2.268% over 30 days. The observed contraction spans multiple windows rather than only the latest hour.

The latest final, parity-validated ETF session showed substantial outflows in both BTC and ETH. Earlier positive BTC-flow context cannot substitute for this newer negative session, although persistence remains unknown.

Over 30 days, BTC returned approximately -7.31%, the median alt returned -15.16%, and only 13 of 49 constituents outperformed BTC. That history supports caution about the durability of the current rebound.
Only 47 of the current 100 breadth constituents outperformed BTC and 33 outperformed ETH. Positive absolute participation has not established broad relative leadership.
